meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's gradebook says zero.
The checker says 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
It's very reliable.

"Very reliable." Fourteen of these tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern, so what else do you have?
I just have a feeling about it.
A feeling. You entered a zero on a feeling, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Flattery isn't a document. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
We're on the same team here.
Teammates call before they enter a zero. Withdraw it, Hale, and apologise to Owen, or I'm going to the principal's office next.
I really think he used something.
My child never lies. "I really think" isn't evidence, so what do you have in your hand?
Kids these days, you know?
"Kids these days" is not a basis for a zero. Owen is one student, so tell me what you have on Owen's essay, or withdraw the mark.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.
"I can tell." Can you show me? Is there a single document with a date on it?
The writing doesn't sound like him.
"Doesn't sound like him." Compared to what? Name the other work you put it next to, and the dates.
He seemed nervous when I asked.
Ten minutes. A seventeen-year-old is nervous when his teacher accuses him, and that's an impression, not evidence. You still haven't answered my question about the other work.
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Then don't act like it. Take the zero off, and put it in writing tonight.
Can we just find a middle ground?
Between what and what? So far you've shown me a score and a feeling. Show me something else, or the zero comes off.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe." A fifty is still a penalty, and you haven't shown me what it's for. Does it go on his record?
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't a document, Hale. Neither is a fifty. Show me what you have on Owen's essay, or the zero comes off today.
What would make you happy?
Happy isn't the question. The zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and it in writing tonight. Or I go to the principal.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then the zero comes off today, in writing, with an apology to Owen. You entered it without evidence, and without calling me first.
I can get more by next week.
Next week is you punishing him first and investigating second. Take the zero off now, and if you find something real, you can bring it to me in writing.
Can we keep talking?
Talk about what? The zero. Do you take it off or not?
Just a few more minutes.
Two minutes. Then I'm at the principal's office. Does the zero come off?
I hear you have a call.
I do, and you're spending it. The zero, Hale. Yes or no?
What time is it?
Almost 4:40. My call is waiting, so you have one minute. The zero, an apology, and it in writing.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
The whole district using it doesn't make it evidence. I'm standing up now: the zero comes off, Owen gets an apology, and I have it in writing tonight, or I go to the principal.
I still think it's right.
The zero comes off and I have it in writing tonight, or I'm at the principal's office next.
Okay.
Okay, the zero comes off, and I have it in writing tonight?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn from Owen's essay and an apology to Owen, both in writing. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen and all of it in writing tonight; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a specific, dated, checkable document in front of her, so she had no reason to give up any ground.
What cost ground: You led with the checker score and called it very reliable, which handed her the strongest argument she had prepared and left you with only a feeling afterwards.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because no times or dates were ever put on the table, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then bring one specific thing with a date on it and name the supervised rewrite in procedure 4.4.
